prompt: service worker FetchEvent replacesClientId engine implementation status
answer:
`FetchEvent.replacesClientId` is specified, but the current Service Workers compatibility data says it is implemented in **no current engines**: Firefox, Safari, Chrome, Opera, Edge, Internet Explorer, and other listed engines are all marked “None.”【https://www.w3.org/TR/service-workers/】

A Firefox 65 release note reported the property as supported, but a WebKit issue later stated that no browser had shipped `replacesClientId` yet.【https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Mozilla/Firefox/Releases/65】【https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=226638】
